description: Complete-call CPU latency and exact numerical validation of the integrated DailyAnalyzer.
measurement_note: Latency samples come from a separate sequential run after regression tests completed. Whole-winter validation ran separately using identical source hashes and input.

methodology.filesystem_cache: Warm: benchmark preflight parses the input and hashing reads it before measurements; no cache flush
methodology.original: Unmodified AST-extracted compute_data and its original file/date helpers
methodology.fresh_engine_first_query: Constructor through first compute_data return; includes loading, validation, date indexing, geometry, templates, and daily computation
methodology.warm_engine_different_day: Complete compute_data call after an untimed different-date query on the same analyzer; includes file fingerprint checks and daily computation
methodology.cache_scope: New analyzer for each case and repetition; instance data and geometry caches; no result caching
methodology.order: Rotate the start among the three timing cases by repetition index; all calls are sequential
methodology.warmup: No topology warmup for fresh engines; preflight warms parser and filesystem cache
methodology.exactness: Numeric equality of full returned lists and full sorted diagram endpoints; signed zeros compare equal
methodology.exit_requirement: Exact numeric agreement for every timed repetition and every requested validation date
methodology.validation_only_note: A validation-only invocation does not perform an original-function bridge or report latency

validation.reference: Existing extended construction with prepared daily arrays and geometry
validation.candidate: DailyAnalyzer.analyze using the selected persistence method and reused caches
